preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer n, where 1 ≤ n ≤ 500.
The second line contains exactly n distinct file names, each with 1 to 8 lowercase letters.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(name) <= 8 and name.islower() and name.isalpha() for name in stdin.splitlines()[1].split())
preconditions.description: Each file name in the second line is a string of 1 to 8 lowercase letters.

preconditions.expression: all('import' in line for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:])
preconditions.description: Each of the n sections starts with a line containing the file name and an integer k, followed by k lines starting with 'import'.

preconditions.expression: all(',' in line or len(line.split()) == 1 for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:] if line.startswith('import'))
preconditions.description: Each 'import' line is comma-space separated or contains exactly one file name.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'SHIP IT' if not any(cycle_detected(files, dependencies) for files in all_possible_cycles(files, dependencies)) else any(cycle == stdout.strip() for cycle in all_possible_cycles(files, dependencies))
postconditions.description: If there are no cyclic dependencies, output 'SHIP IT'. Otherwise, output a shortest cycle in the order of the cycle.
